jobs.title: CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
jobs.description:
Job Description

What began as a single-facility machine shop has grown into a two-location, multi-market precision manufacturer whose customer-first culture now serves the most demanding programs in national defense alongside the leading names in commercial industry. That disciplined diversification has positioned the company for its next chapter — and for the President and CEO who will lead it.

Today, this privately held company employs 110 people in 2 locations with revenue at 32 million dollars annually. The company has a thriving Aerospace & Defense line of business with more than 800 Level 1 contracts awarded. Commercial lines of business include relationships with the top four elevator industry OEM’s, and transportation OEM’s.

Job Responsibilities

Total ownership and commitment to corporate safety, financial performance, customer relationships, partnerships and manufacturing outcomes, involving over 200,000 sq. ft. of manufacturing and office space on multiple campuses.
Actively champion a culture of kaizen and lean manufacturing, controlling enterprise resources, and production strategies to ensure the most efficient and effective utilization of materials, equipment and labor.
Perpetuate and enhance an environment which, daily, promotes employee development. Ensure succession from within.
Provide executive direction in partnerships including a $40M joint venture delivering complete elevator systems, and a mature office of government contracting.
Collaborate with the Chair and corporate boards, on key financial decisions, product direction, corporate culture, vision, values and executive assignment.

Profile And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering (MBA Preferred)
Manufacturing experience with a strong Metal Fabrication, Machining, Welding and Assembly background. Engineering and Quality “best practice” point of reference.
Experience leading Aerospace and Defense contract manufacturing.
Experience and strong track record with the development of people and building bench strength
10 plus years of experience in a senior level, leadership role. Preference is for candidates with experience in roles that had total ownership of Profit / Loss, and Sales results.
Demonstrated ability to drive changes through influence and collaboration in a team environment.
Excellent communication, presentation and relationship management skills, collaborative style effective internal and external relations.
Position reports to the Chair of the Board.

For Further Information, Contact
